annotations.title: Solana Whale Wallet Net-Flow & Insider Cluster Tracker

description: Tracks 24-hour net accumulation or distribution flows across top Solana whale wallets and flags coordinated insider wallet clusters for a given SPL token. Use when analyzing on-chain smart-money order flow and holder clustering on Solana; for checking static SPL contract mint/freeze authority permissions, use evaluate_solana_token_risk instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'token' ('window' defaults to '1h'), supports '?demo=true' or x402 (500 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

token.description: Base58 Solana SPL token mint address or ticker symbol to track whale flows for.

window.description: Aggregation lookback window for net whale flow; defaults to '24h' when omitted.

name: track_solana_whale_flows

insider_cluster_detected.description: True if synchronized funding patterns indicate an insider wallet cluster.

net_flow_24h_usd.description: Signed 24-hour net whale flow denominated in USD.

title: Solana Whale Wallet Net-Flow & Insider Cluster Tracker
